name: krafty-sprouts/adplacr
label: Ad Placr
description: Places your ad code inside articles, at the paragraph or heading you choose.
author: Krafty Sprouts Media, LLC

settings.label: Mobile breakpoint
settings.description: Screens narrower than this many pixels get the mobile ad code. WordPress Ad Placr used 782.

settings.label: Tablet breakpoint
settings.description: Screens wider than the mobile breakpoint and narrower than this are tablets. Keep it above the mobile value.

settings.label: Count impressions and clicks
settings.description: Off by default. When on, the plugin counts how often each ad is seen and clicked, per day. No personal information is kept.

settings.label: Keep statistics for
settings.description: Daily counts older than this are removed automatically.

settings.label: Statistics key
settings.description: Teme requires a key behind every public address that receives data. Ad Placr does not use its value; you can leave it empty.

settings.label: Ad 1: name
settings.description: A name only you see, so you can tell your ads apart.

settings.label: Ad 1: status
settings.description: An ad is shown only while it is Active and has ad code.

settings.label: Ad 1: where it appears
settings.description: Where in the article the ad is placed. Only paragraphs and headings at the top level of the article count, never ones inside a list, quote or table.

options.near_end: Near the end (before the last paragraph)

settings.label: Ad 1: paragraph number
settings.description: Used by "After paragraph number", "Before paragraph number" and "After every few paragraphs" (then it is the step).

settings.label: Ad 1: most repeats
settings.description: Used by "After every few paragraphs": the most times the ad is repeated in one article. Teme never repeats more than 10 times.

settings.label: Ad 1: heading level
settings.description: Used by the heading locations: 2 means an h2 heading.

settings.label: Ad 1: which heading
settings.description: Used by the heading locations: 1 means the first heading of that level.

settings.label: Ad 1: ad code
settings.description: The code from your ad network. Scripts that load from a web address and iframes work; scripts written inline in the code are removed by Teme.

settings.label: Ad 1: mobile ad code
settings.description: Optional. Shown instead of the ad code on screens under the mobile breakpoint.

settings.label: Ad 1: alignment
settings.description: Where the ad sits in the column. "None" leaves the ad code as it is.

settings.label: Ad 1: show on
settings.description: The screen sizes the ad is shown on. Choose none to show on all.

settings.label: Ad 1: content types
settings.description: Show only in these content types, separated by commas, such as post, page. Leave empty to show in all.

settings.label: Ad 1: categories and tags
settings.description: Show only in articles that have one of these terms, as taxonomy:id separated by commas. Leave empty to show in all.

settings.label: Ad 1: languages
settings.description: Show only in articles in these languages, such as en, fr. Leave empty to show in all.

settings.label: Ad 1: start
settings.description: Do not show before this date and time, in the site's time zone. Leave empty to start at once.

settings.label: Ad 1: end
settings.description: Do not show after this date and time, in the site's time zone. Leave empty to never end.

settings.label: Ad 1: version B ad code
settings.description: Optional. A second version of the ad. Each time the page is drawn, one version is chosen by its weight.

settings.label: Ad 1: version B mobile ad code
settings.description: Optional mobile code for version B.

settings.label: Ad 1: version A weight
settings.description: How often version A is chosen. 3 and 1 means 75% and 25%.

settings.label: Ad 1: version B weight
settings.description: How often version B is chosen.
